hypothesis: Generalizing the Factorization Machine to a Field-weighted FM (FwFM) will allow the model to learn the importance of different field-pair interactions, upweighting critical crosses like user-video while discounting noisy ones, raising primary.
rationale: Following the directive to implement structural improvements that clear the +0.002 threshold, adding field-weighted interactions to the FM provides a new modeling capability. The baseline FM treats all field crosses equally, but within-user ranking heavily depends on specific pairs (user-video, user-tab). FwFM changes the *form* of the interaction, directly addressing the limitations noted in the knowledge library for feature-interaction models.

harness_extra.gain_evidence: The organizers noted that capacity increases (higher k) and additional static fields do not improve the plain FM, implying uniform field interactions are a bottleneck. Field-weighted FM (FwFM, Pan et al., 2018) specifically addresses this by learning which field pairs matter most. Because R is initialized to 1.0, it starts mathematically identical to the proven champion, ensuring low risk.
harness_extra.ablation_plan: no_fwfm: bundle without the FwFM capability (i.e. freeze_r=True, staying mathematically identical to the base FM).
